title: DeluxeEggs
description: Best Free EGG Cosmetic Solution for your Server !
body:
🥚 DeluxeEggs

Hide custom Easter Eggs around your server for players to discover! DeluxeEggs is a fun and lightweight way to create seasonal events, hub activities, or spawn-area scavenger hunts that encourage exploration and reward your community. Everything can be managed directly in-game, making setup quick, simple, and easy to maintain.

## ✨ In-Game GUI Editor

Create and manage hidden eggs, edit rewards, change messages, and teleport to egg locations without touching a config file. Just use `/ee menu`.

## 🎨 Flexible Egg Customization

Make every hidden egg fit your server’s style. DeluxeEggs supports HeadDatabase (`hdb:<id>`), Base64 textures, and player heads (`zhead:<name>`), so you can create unique collectibles for seasonal events, quests, or custom adventures.

---

## Customization & Settings

DeluxeEggs is designed to be plug-and-play. Nearly everything can be managed without touching a configuration file. Egg locations, rewards, and custom discovery messages can all be edited live in-game through the built-in GUI editor.

For advanced users, the `config.yml` provides additional options such as:

- toggling fireworks and specific particles on discovery
- adjusting the claim method (Click, Walk Over, or Both)
- changing the plugin prefix and default egg skins
- enabling Hex colors for 1.16+ versions

## Commands

| Command | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/ee menu` | `deluxeeggs.admin` | Open the full GUI editor to manage eggs |
| `/ee create` | `deluxeeggs.admin` | Turn your held item into a placeable Easter Egg |
| `/ee set` | `deluxeeggs.admin` | Set the block you are currently looking at as an egg |
| `/ee give` | `deluxeeggs.admin` | Give an egg item (supports HeadDatabase, ZHead, and Base64) |
| `/ee edit <id>` | `deluxeeggs.admin` | Open the GUI editor for a specific egg |
| `/ee tp <id>` | `deluxeeggs.admin` | Teleport instantly to an egg's location |
| `/ee list` | `deluxeeggs.admin` | List all hidden eggs and their coordinates |
| `/ee reload` | `deluxeeggs.admin` | Reload the plugin configuration and messages |
| `/ee found` | None | Let players check their personal discovery progress |

OP players will have all permissions. To manually grant permissions, use LuckPerms.

---

## General Features

- **Custom Rewards:** Run any console commands when a player finds an egg, such as giving money, items, ranks, tags, or other rewards.
- **Rich Feedback:** Celebrate discoveries with Titles/Subtitles, customizable particles, level-up sounds, and fireworks.
- **PlaceholderAPI Support:** Show player progress on scoreboards, tab lists, or in chat.
- **Claim Methods:** Choose how players interact with eggs in the config — Click, Walk Over, or Both.

## Some Advice

- To use the `hdb:<id>` shortcut in the `/ee give` command, you must have the HeadDatabase plugin installed on your server.
- For placeholders, make sure PlaceholderAPI is installed and working properly.
- All player-facing messages, prefixes, particles, and sounds are fully translatable and customizable in the `config.yml` and `messages.yml` files.
